label: Tuljapur taluka, Dharashiv - real village locations (OSM) + Census 2011 population; livestock / source status / requests / trips / GPS SIMULATED

data_sources.village_locations: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API, place=village in OSM relation 10349973 (Tuljapur taluka). (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
data_sources.population: Census 2011 village totals, Tuljapur sub-district 04241 (Osmanabad district), via https://www.census2011.co.in/data/subdistrict/4241-tuljapur-osmanabad-maharashtra.html
data_sources.fill_point: OSM place=town 'Tuljapur' (taluka HQ) - ASSUMED filling point, not confirmed
data_sources.fill_points: Tuljapur (base) + Naldurg (optional second), OSM place=town - ASSUMED, not confirmed

fleet.note: thresholds from a heuristic solve per fleet size (upper bounds); None = not reached in sweep

reasons: b short_stop: longest stop at Apsinga was 5 min (< 15 min = 75% of unload time)
c no_refill: 20,000 L claimed since the last filling-point stop (capacity 10,000 L)
a no_gps_visit: no GPS point within 300 m of Suratgaon between 09:30 and 11:30
a no_gps_visit: no GPS point within 300 m of Suratgaon between 12:30 and 14:30
a no_gps_visit: no GPS point within 300 m of Borgaon between 10:35 and 12:35
d impossible_speed: 60.8 km from Apsinga (C018) in 8 min = 456 km/h (> 60 km/h)
